title: A Ember for the Choir Again
author: Marguerite Reyes
blurb: Coral Delacroix, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
